category: Historical or Non-Metric Units of Length
explanation: Rod, Furlong, League, and Cubit are all non-metric units of length, many with historical origins or specific uses outside of the modern SI system. Kilometer is a standard unit in the metric (SI) system.

category: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The first four tokens are universally recognized as four of the original Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Machu Picchu is a significant historical site and a 'New7Wonder of the World,' but it was not part of the traditional ancient list.

category: Verbs of Gradual Diminishment or Disappearance
explanation: Wane, dwindle, erode, and fade all describe a process of gradual reduction, decrease, or disappearance. Flourish means to grow or thrive.
